designationHistory.indexText: The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service established Bayou Teche National Wildlife Refuge by buying land to conserve the Louisiana black bear.

authority.citation: Land purchase by the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Bayou Teche National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

USFWS, 508 Bayou Teche National Wildlife Refuge Comprehensive Conservation Plan (ServCat 168179): "Bayou Teche NWR was established on October 31, 2001, when the Service purchased 9,028 acres from the Trust for Public Lands"

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Bayou Teche National Wildlife Refuge, established in 2001, sits along Bayou Teche, an ancient channel of the Mississippi River.

historySource: Refuge About Us pages, fws.gov (draft, pending review)
